headline: Amendments to use regulations, towing/highway business rules, and inclusionary zoning ordinance.
summary: The committee will consider amending the city's use regulations ordinance (MCC 12.12.030) and the inclusionary zoning ordinance (MCC 12.12.300), including a new incentives sub-section.
items: Ordinance 327-26: amend MCC 12.12.030 Use Regulations, sponsored by Ari Taylor, Stephen Winslow and Ryan O'Malley
Ordinance 335-26: strike and replace MCC 12.12.300 Inclusionary Zoning, sponsored by Stephen Winslow
Ordinance 335A-26: add new sub-section F. INCENTIVES to MCC 12.12.300 Inclusionary Zoning, sponsored by Stephen Winslow
